prompt: Given `const scores = [60, 80, 100];` print the average of the scores.
solution:
const total = scores.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0);
console.log(total / scores.length);
hint: Add the numbers up (a loop or `reduce`), then divide by `scores.length`.
